title: Desk and Magnetic Chess Set
summary: Two personal builds: a wooden desk built from my own CAD drawings and a 3D-printed magnetic chess set modeled from scratch.
result: Modeled every chess piece without reference models and embedded hand-placed neodymium magnets so the set holds even upside down.
spec: I built a wooden desk from CAD drawings I produced myself.
I modeled every piece of a magnetic chess set from scratch without reference models, printed them in matte PLA, and embedded hand-placed neodymium magnets with adhesive.
cover_alt: Hand holding the magnetic chess board upside down with all of the printed pieces still attached.
cover_caption: The chess board held upside down. The embedded magnets keep every piece in place.
